title: DNA identified as the bacterial transforming principle
summary: Avery, MacLeod and McCarty showed that DNA, not protein, transforms bacteria from one type to another. Destroying DNA stopped the effect; destroying protein or RNA did not.
why: Pointed science at DNA as the carrier of heredity.

unsung.contribution: Showed in 1944, with MacLeod and McCarty, that DNA is the transforming principle.
unsung.recognition: Nominated through three decades but never awarded; called the most deserving scientist not to receive the Nobel.
